description: This file contains the code-behind logic for the AdminQueue page of the Online Examination System. It manages session validation, database checks for course queue status, and navigation between pages.

classes.name: AdminQueue
classes.description: Partial class representing the code-behind for the AdminQueue ASP.NET webpage, handling page events and user interactions.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the initial page load. Checks session variables, validates course queue data, and performs database cleanup if the queue is empty.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the Admin Panel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the Admin Queue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the Admin Leaderboard page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles user logout and redirects to the Login page.

methods.name: GridView1_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection of a row in the GridView, storing selected student and course IDs in session variables and redirecting to the show answers page.
